3. Initialize the daily tip selection config file (`daily-tips.json`) with a sensible starting structure that references the available tips
4. Initialize the send log file (`tips-log.md`) with a header or initial entry

The system should be fully bootstrapped and ready for the automated daily schedule to take over.
